description: This donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different stimulus types used in the study, with each segment corresponding to a specific category and its percentage share. The chart contains eight distinct slices, each labeled with its category name and percentage value. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 26.4%, colored a deep red. Following this are “Press Release” at 18.7% (yellow), “External News Article” at 18.1% (dark green), “Interview” at 8.8% (dark purple), “Organizational Report” at 7.7% (light purple), “Event Posting” at 6.6% (dark red), “Organizational Website” at 4.9% (dark blue), and “Intra-agency news article” also at 4.9% (light blue). The smallest segment is “Social Media Post” at 1.1% (light yellow). Each category’s label and percentage are clearly displayed outside the ring, and the chart is organized with the largest segments positioned at the top and bottom, followed by descending order around the circle. There is no legend, and no slice is exploded or visually emphasized beyond standard rendering.
